info.title: UBT_Zone
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

bucket_map.description: Bucket map information as provided by the SAC node.

active_uac.description: IP address of the active node for this bucket-id.

connectivity_type.description: Connectivity type.  `L2`: active and standby controller nodes are on the same IP         subnet.  `L3`: active and standby controller nodes are not part on the         same IP subnet.

standby_uac.description: IP address of the stand-by node for this bucket-id.

cluster_alias.description: User provided name for the cluster. This is advertised to the switch as part of the cluster-switch handshake.

controller_nodes.description: IP address of the primary and backup controller nodes.

controller_nodes_handshake_state.description: `not_started`:            handshake with the controller has not                             started yet.  `in_progress`:            handshake with the controller is                             in progress.  `compatibility_mismatch`: controller node not capable of supporting client                            based UBT functionality.  `ready_for_bootstrap`:    handshake complete and ready for next phase of the                            control plane sequence.

enable.description: Enables UBT functionality for this zone.

failure_reason.description: Failure reason. Only applicable when operational_state is 'down'.

node_list.description: IP address of the controller nodes in the UBT cluster.

papi_security_key.description: Shared security key that will be used to encrypt UBT PAPI messages exchanged between this switch and the controller cluster corresponding to this zone. when not set, shared security key is not used for encrypting papi messages.

sac_heartbeat_interval.description: Time interval (in seconds) between successive  heartbeat messages to the switch anchor node.

sac_node_statistics.description: Statistics of various control plane packets exchanged between the switch and  the active and standby switch anchor controllers.

bucketmap_ack_rx.description: Number of bucket map acknowledgment packets received.

bucketmap_rx.description: Number of bucket map packets transmitted.

failover_ack_rx.description: Number of failover acknowledgment packets received.

nodelist_ack_rx.description: Number of nodelist acknowledgment packets received.

unbootstrap_ack_rx.description: Number of unbootstrap acknowledgment packets received.

wol_bootstrap_ack_rx.description: Number of Wake-on-LAN bootstrap acknowledgment packets received.

wol_bootstrap_tx.description: Number of Wake-on-LAN bootstrap packets transmitted.

sac_nodes.description: IP address, Ethernet MAC address and bootstrap state of the  active and standby switch anchor controller nodes.

mac_address.description: Ethernet MAC address of the node.

state.description: Switch bootstrap state of the node:  `registering`:   bootstrap process is on-going.  `registered`:    device has bootstrapped with the node.  `unregistering`: device de-registering from the node.

switch_bootstrap_state.description: `not_started`:            bootstrap process has not started.  `bootstrapping`:          bootstrap process is on-going.  `standalone`:             device has bootstrapped with the SAC node.  `redundant`:              device has bootstrapped with the SAC and                             the Standby-SAC nodes.  `failover`:               heartbeat to the SAC node timedout and                             the device is failing over to the Standby-SAC.  `unbootstrapping`:        de-registering from the SAC and Standby-SAC nodes.

uac_keepalive_interval.description: Time interval (in seconds) between successive  keep-alive messages sent to the user anchor node.

vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [UBT_Zone](#/UBT_Zone)
VRF associated with this zone.

wol_bootstrap_state.description: IP address, Wake-on-LAN VLAN bootstrap state, registered and failed VLAN list of the active and standby switch anchor  controller nodes.

state.description: Wake-on-LAN bootstrap state of the node:  `registering`:  bootstrap process is on-going.  `registered`:   bootstrap is successful with the node.  `failed`:       bootstrap failed or partially succeeded with the node.  `timed_out`:    bootstrap process timed out.  `incompatible`: controller is not capable of supporting WoL                  VLAN bootstrap functionality.

wol_vlans.description: Wake-on-LAN VLAN configuration. This is applicable only for VLAN Extend mode.

parameters.name: VRF.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF identifier. Should be alphanumeric. VRF names must be unique.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)

uac_keepalive_interval.description: Time interval (in seconds) between successive  keep-alive messages sent to the user anchor node.
